turns.input: *stops an ordinary passer-by* "When do the slave auctions happen?"
turns.narration:
The passer-by slows, given pause by the directness of the question. He is a middle-aged man with weathered hands and a faded wool coat, the sort who might be coming from or going to any ordinary errand in the capital. He looks Nicco up and down with mild curiosity, nothing more.

"Slave auctions?" He scratches his jaw. "The market's in the West District—anyone around here could point you that way. But as for when they hold the sales..." He shrugs, shaking his head. "I don't keep track. You'll have to ask there, or find someone who does business with them."

He stands waiting, neither eager to flee nor inclined to linger, the massive wooden doors of Heartstone looming behind the exchange.

"Before you? I wouldn't know. Never heard who owned it." She shrugs, adjusting her grip on the basket. "Never been inside, myself. It's stood empty long as I've noticed it, but that's only my own years. Before my time, if there was anyone."

She does not linger, offering no further speculation, and continues on her way toward whatever business drew her past the tower this morning.
